40021826.author: पदार्थः
40021826.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, मैथिलीं Maithili, सीताम् Sita, आश्रमे in the hermitage, सम्प्रवेशिताम् having been led in, सन्तापम् sorrow, अगमत् experienced, घोरम् terrible, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a distressed mind.

40021826.author: Translation
40021826.content: Indeed, having seen Maithili Sita led into the hermitage, Lakshmana, with a distressed mind, experienced terrible sorrow.

40021827.author: पदार्थः
40021827.content: अब्रवीत् spoke, च and, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent, सुमन्त्रं to Sumantra, मन्त्रसारथिम् the wise charioteer, सीतासन्तापजं born of Sita's distress, दुःखं sorrow, पश्य behold, रामस्य of Rama, सारथे O charioteer.

40021827.author: Translation
40021827.content: And the greatly effulgent Lakshmana spoke to Sumantra, the wise charioteer, saying, 'O charioteer, behold Rama's sorrow born of Sita's distress!'

40021828.author: पदार्थः
40021828.content: ततः than that, दुःखतरं more sorrowful, किं what, नु indeed, राघवस्य for Rama, भविष्यति will there be, पत्नीं wife, शुद्धसमाचारां of pure conduct, विसृज्य having abandoned, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter.

40021828.author: Translation
40021828.content: Indeed, what could be more sorrowful for Rama than having abandoned his wife, Janaka's daughter, who is of pure conduct?

40021829.author: पदार्थः
40021829.content: व्यक्तं clearly, दैवात् from destiny, अहं I, मन्ये believe, राघवस्य of Rama, विना without, भवम् being (separation), वैदेह्या from Vaidehi (Sita), सारथे O charioteer, नित्यं always, दैवं destiny, हि indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् insurmountable.

40021829.author: Translation
40021829.content: O charioteer, I clearly believe that Rama's separation from Sita is due to destiny, for destiny is always insurmountable.

40021830.author: पदार्थः
40021830.content: यः who, हि indeed, देवान् gods, सगन्धर्वान् along with Gandharvas, असुरान् Asuras, सह with, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, निहन्यात् would kill, राघवः Rama, क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, दैवम् destiny, अनुवर्तते follows.

40021830.author: Translation
40021830.content: Even Rama, who when enraged could indeed destroy gods, Gandharvas, Asuras, and Rakshasas, still follows destiny.

40021831.author: पदार्थः
40021831.content: पुरा formerly, रामः Rama, पितुः father's, वाक्यात् from command, दण्डके in Dandaka, विजने solitary, वने forest, उषित्वा having resided, नव nine, वर्षाणि years, पञ्च five, च and, एव indeed, महावने in the great forest.

40021831.author: Translation
40021831.content: Formerly, Rama, obeying his father's command, resided for fourteen years in the solitary Dandaka forest and other great forests.

40021832.author: पदार्थः
40021832.content: ततः than that, दुःखतरं more sorrowful, भूयः again, सीतायाः of Sita, विप्रवासनम् banishment, पौराणां of the citizens, वचनं words, श्रुत्वा having heard, नृशंसं cruel, प्रतिभाति appears, मे to me.

40021832.author: Translation
40021832.content: Having heard the words of the citizens, Sita's banishment appears to me even more sorrowful than his previous sufferings, and indeed cruel.

40021833.author: पदार्थः
40021833.content: कः what, नु indeed, धर्माश्रयः basis of righteousness, सूत O charioteer, कर्मणि in this act, अस्मिन् this, यशोहरे destroying fame, मैथिलीं regarding Maithili (Sita), प्रतिसम्प्राप्तः obtained (here, concerning), पौरैः by the citizens, हीनार्थवादिभिः speaking meaningless words.

40021833.author: Translation
40021833.content: O charioteer, what basis of righteousness is there in this act, which destroys fame, concerning Sita, especially when it is based on the meaningless words spoken by the citizens?

40021834.author: पदार्थः
40021834.content: एताः these, वाचः words, बहुविधाः of many kinds, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणभाषिताः spoken by Lakshmana, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, श्रद्धया with faith, प्राज्ञः wise, वाक्यम् statement, एतत् this, उवाच spoke, ह indeed

40021834.author: Translation
40021834.content: Having heard these various words spoken by Lakshmana, the wise Sumantra, with faith, indeed spoke this statement.

40021835.author: पदार्थः
40021835.content: न not, सन्तापः sorrow, त्वया by you, कार्यः should be done, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra (Lakshmana), मैथिलीम् regarding Maithili (Sita), प्रति towards, दृष्टम् seen/foretold, एतत् this, पुरा formerly, विप्रैः by sages, पितुः of your father, ते your, लक्ष्मणाग्रतः in front of Lakshmana

40021835.author: Translation
40021835.content: O Lakshmana, you should not feel sorrow regarding Sita, for this very event was foretold long ago by sages in the presence of your father.

40021836.author: पदार्थः
40021836.content: भविष्यति will be, दृढम् certainly, रामः Rama, दुःखप्रायः predominantly sorrowful, अपि even though, सौख्यभाक् partaker of happiness, प्राप्स्यते will obtain, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, विप्रयोगम् separation, प्रियैः from dear ones, ध्रुवम् certainly

40021836.author: Translation
40021836.content: Rama, though predominantly sorrowful, will certainly experience happiness, and the mighty-armed one will undoubtedly face separation from his dear ones.

40021837.author: पदार्थः
40021837.content: त्वाम् you, च and, एव indeed, मैथिलीम् Maithili (Sita), च and, एव indeed, शत्रुघ्नभरतौ Shatrughna and Bharata, उभौ both, सन्त्यजिष्यति will abandon, धर्मात्मा the righteous-souled one, कालेन by time, महता great/long, महान् the great one (Rama)

40021837.author: Translation
40021837.content: The great and righteous Rama will indeed abandon you, Maithili, and both Shatrughna and Bharata, after a long period of time.

40021838.author: पदार्थः
40021838.content: इदम् this, त्वयि to you, न not, वक्तव्यम् to be spoken, सौमित्रे O son of Sumitra (Lakshmana), भरते to Bharata, अपि even, वा or, राज्ञा by the king (Dasharatha), वः to you (plural), व्याहृतम् spoken, वाक्यम् words/statement, दुर्वासाः Durvasa (the sage), यत् which, उवाच spoke, ह indeed

40021838.author: Translation
40021838.content: O Lakshmana, this statement, which Durvasa indeed spoke to the king and which the king then spoke to you all, should not be revealed to you or even to Bharata.

40021839.author: पदार्थः
40021839.content: महाजनसमीपे in the presence of great people, च and, मम my, चैव and indeed, नरर्षभ O best among men, ऋषिणा by the sage, व्याहृतं spoken, वाक्यं statement, वसिष्ठस्य of Vasistha, च and, सन्निधौ in the presence.

40021839.author: Translation
40021839.content: O best among men, this statement was spoken by the sage (Valmiki) in a large gathering, in my presence, and also in the presence of Vasistha.

40021840.author: पदार्थः
40021840.content: ऋषेस्तु but of the sage, वचनं statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, मामाह said to me, पुरुषर्षभः the best among men, सूत O charioteer, न not, क्वचिदेवं anywhere thus, ते by you, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, जनसन्निधौ in the presence of people.

40021840.author: Translation
40021840.content: Having heard the sage's words, the best among men (Rama) said to me, "O charioteer, you should never speak thus in the presence of people."

40021841.author: पदार्थः
40021841.content: तस्याहं of him I, लोकपालस्य of the protector of the world, वाक्यं command, तत्सुसमाहितः that very carefully, नैव never indeed, जात्वनृतं ever untrue, कार्यमिति to be done thus, मे my, सौम्य O gentle one, दर्शनम् view.

40021841.author: Translation
40021841.content: O gentle one, I carefully consider that command of the protector of the world (Rama), for it is my view that one should never utter an untruth.

40021842.author: पदार्थः
40021842.content: सर्वथैव in every way indeed, न not, वक्तव्यं to be spoken, मया by me, सौम्य O gentle one, तवाग्रतः in front of you, यदि if, ते your, श्रवणे in listening, श्रद्धा faith, श्रूयतां let it be heard, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40021842.author: Translation
40021842.content: O gentle one, I should not speak of this in front of you at all; however, O delight of the Raghus, if you have faith in listening, then let it be heard.

40021843.author: पदार्थः
40021843.content: यद्यप्यहं although I, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, रहस्यं secret, श्रावितः made to hear, पुरा formerly, तथाप्युदाहरिष्यामि nevertheless I will narrate, दैवं destiny, हि indeed, दुरतिक्रमम् difficult to overcome.

40021843.author: Translation
40021843.content: Although the king (Rama) previously told me this secret, I will nevertheless narrate it, for destiny is indeed difficult to overcome.

40021844.author: पदार्थः
40021844.content: येन by whom, इदम् this, ईदृशम् such, प्राप्तम् obtained, दुःखम् sorrow, शोकसमन्वितम् accompanied by grief, न not, त्वया by you, भरते to Bharata, वाच्यम् to be spoken, शत्रुघ्नस्यापि even in Shatrughna's, सन्निधौ presence,

40021844.author: Translation
40021844.content: This sorrow, accompanied by grief, which has been experienced, should not be spoken of by you to Bharata, nor even in the presence of Shatrughna.

40021845.author: पदार्थः
40021845.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, भाषितम् speech, तस्य his, गम्भीरार्थपदम् having profound meaning in words, महत् great, तथ्यम् the truth, ब्रूहि tell, इति thus, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, सूतम् to the charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke,

40021845.author: Translation
40021845.content: Having heard his profound and significant words, Lakshmana then spoke to the charioteer, saying, "Tell me the truth.". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 50 ।। Thus ends the fiftieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
